result.instructions: Tools for Saldeo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the companies in our SaldeoSMART office account."; "Show the documents of company X that were sent for export."; "Which cost invoices are in the October 2026 folder of this company?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Saldeo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run saldeo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run saldeo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run saldeo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. saldeo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: saldeo_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (clients) the Saldeo user can see: COMPANY_PROGRAM_ID (needed by every other tool), COMPANY_ID, names, VAT number, address, bank accounts. Start here. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/company/list.

limit.description: Entries per list in the reply, 1-1000 (default 100). The reply's "paging" says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many entries of each list (default 0); use paging.next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: saldeo_list_contractors
tools.description: List the contractors (suppliers and customers) of one company: names, VAT number (NIP), address, bank accounts, e-mails, payment days. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/contractor/list.

company_program_id.description: The company's COMPANY_PROGRAM_ID, as returned by saldeo_list_companies.

limit.description: Entries per list in the reply, 1-1000 (default 50). The reply's "paging" says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many entries of each list (default 0); use paging.next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: saldeo_search_documents
tools.description: Find documents of one company by field (at least one of document_id, number, nip, guid; several are combined with AND). Returns the matching documents. Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.1/document/search (policy BY_FIELDS).

company_program_id.description: The company's COMPANY_PROGRAM_ID, as returned by saldeo_list_companies.

limit.description: Entries per list in the reply, 1-1000 (default 50). The reply's "paging" says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many entries of each list (default 0); use paging.next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: saldeo_list_document_ids

company_program_id.description: The company's COMPANY_PROGRAM_ID, as returned by saldeo_list_companies.

year.description: Year of the Saldeo folder (the month the document is booked in), e.g. 2026.

limit.description: Entries per list in the reply, 1-1000 (default 500). The reply's "paging" says how many exist and the next offset.
